chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated from his father, from Isma'il ibn Marar, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman who linked it up to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

He said: This is among what the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) advised Ali (peace be upon him) with: 'O Ali! I admonish you against three major characteristics: jealousy, greed, and lying. O Ali! The master of deeds are three characteristics: treating people fairly regarding yourself, kindness to your brother for the sake of God, the Exalted, and remembering God, the Blessed and Exalted, in all circumstances. O Ali! A believer has three sources of happiness in this world: meeting his brethren, breaking his fast, and night prayer at the end of the night. O Ali! Three things lacking which means nothing of what you do is perfected: piety which prevents you from disobeying God, the Exalted; good temper which assists him to treat the people with moderation; and patience which helps him forgive the ignorance of the people. O Ali! Three things are due to real faith: generosity in spite of poverty; recognizing that others are right regarding oneself; and teaching knowledge to its seekers. O Ali! Three characteristics are due to nobility: giving to those who have denied things of you; associating with those who have cut-off ties from you; and forgiving those who have oppressed you.'
ai.seo_question: What are the three master deeds and three sources of happiness for a believer according to the Prophet's advice to Ali?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, this hadith encapsulates the Prophet’s ethical blueprint for Ali (AS), linking inner piety (*war'*) with social conduct to ensure the validity of deeds. It emphasizes that true faith manifests through generosity in hardship and intellectual generosity, while spiritual joy is found in communal bonds and night worship (*tahajjud*). This text serves as a foundational guide for Shia moral theology, balancing asceticism with active social engagement.
